name: Geniee
note: Footer SVG from en.geniee.co.jp (the header logo is only a 184px PNG). Icon + GENIEE wordmark. The white inner shape of the round icon was dropped so the cut-out stays transparent instead of merging into a disc.

name: AdPushup
note: No SVG on adpushup.com. The current header image is an "adpushup by GENIEE" webp (kept as raw/adpushup-by-geniee.webp); used the plain adpushup wordmark PNG (961px, transparent) that the page JSON-LD references, since Geniee has its own slot in the strip. Raster conversion: alpha-kept, near-white knocked out.

name: Zelto
note: SKIPPED. zelto.ai now belongs to an unrelated company (voice-AI QA, "Production QA for voice AI agents"); its wordmark is kept as raw/zelto-logo.png for reference only and must not be used. Wayback has no snapshot of the 2023 AdPushup-era Zelto site, and adpushup.com no longer references Zelto, so no distinct logo exists.

name: Embee
note: Header SVG from embee.co.in: "embee" wordmark with (R) and the "Making IT Easier" tagline. Two-colour wordmark flattened to one colour; letterforms stay separate.

name: Microsoft
note: microsoft.com renders its header logo via JS (no SVG/PNG in the HTML); used the Wikimedia Commons 2012 logo SVG. Four squares + wordmark, all #111111; the squares keep their gaps.

name: TestMu AI
note: Header SVG from testmuai.com. The second line "Formerly LambdaTest" was removed (paths below y=25) and duplicated wordmark paths deduped, leaving the mark + "TestMu AI".

name: Hirect
note: DOUBTFUL QUALITY. hirect.in (and hirect.co / hirect.ai) time out from this network and Clearbit is unreachable; the only source obtained is a Wayback Machine capture of the site header PNG whose mark is just 110px wide, upscaled to 600px, so it is soft. Larger captures (footer 2025, header 2023) were rate-limited (HTTP 429) on three paced attempts. Re-fetch from hirect.in when reachable. Picked the widest capture available, hirect-wayback-2024.png (172x48 source). Raster conversion: alpha-kept, near-white knocked out.

name: RattanIndia
note: Header SVG from rattanindia.com: "RattanIndia ENTERPRISES" in white on a solid green box. The green background rect was removed and the text/rule recoloured, so the mark is now a dark wordmark on transparent.

name: Canon
note: global.canon's header SVG carries a grey "Global" suffix (kept as raw/canon.svg); used the Wikimedia Commons Canon wordmark SVG instead.

name: CenturyPly
note: centuryply.com's "logo.svg" is only a wrapper around an embedded 1006x453 PNG (no vector paths), so that raster was extracted and converted. Emblem + CENTURYPLY wordmark; near-white pixels knocked out to transparent. Raster conversion: alpha-kept, near-white knocked out.

name: Coca-Cola
note: coca-cola.com's brand SVG is the script inside a red disc (raw/cocacola-brand.svg) and the only other asset is "The Coca-Cola Company" lockup (raw/cocacola-company-black.svg); used the Commons Coca-Cola script wordmark (single path).

name: REHAU
note: rehau.com answers curl with an Akamai 403 unless full browser headers are sent, and the served HTML has no logo asset (icon font / JS). Used the Wikimedia Commons REHAU logo SVG: segmented ring mark + REHAU wordmark.

name: The Vedic School
note: Horizontal "The Vedic School" wordmark PNG from the site (1024px, opaque white background) converted with luminance-as-alpha. The site also ships a mascot-only PNG (raw/vedicschool-v25.png), not used. Raster conversion: luminance-as-alpha.

name: Dextr AI
note: Header SVG from dextr.ai: mark + "Dextr AI" wordmark, recoloured from #232323 to #111111.
